svg.aria-label: Parameters: rai’s reader is one square of 33 million; GPT-3 is about 5,300 such squares
svg.title: Parameters: rai’s reader is one square of 33 million; GPT-3 is about 5,300 such squares
svg.text: How many dials? One square is 33 million parameters
the reader inside rai: about 33 million, one square
GPT-3, an early large model: 175 billion, about 5,303 squares
Every square is as big as the whole of rai’s reader, which is the red one at the top left.
